baseline_models.focus_anchor: The beneficiary phrase لربك governs the imperative فاصبر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship supplies the governing orientation, while patience supplies restraint from panic; the command is controlled endurance rendered for the Lord rather than undirected stoicism.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the exclusive authority and beneficiary governing the command.
Self-restraint from panic supplies the command's core operation: holding reaction under sovereign direction.

changed_reading.before: Be patient in a general moral sense.
changed_reading.after: For your Lord, govern panic and reaction under his authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same لربك and فاصبر construction joins divine nurture to continued bearing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord repairs and brings a charge to completion stage by stage; patience is the servant's durable standing with that charge while its completion remains in the Lord's care.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord's relation an ongoing formative process rather than a bare title.
Staying, clinging, and lasting supply the temporal durability of remaining with that formative process.
Bearing surety or standing with someone casts patience as continued fidelity to an entrusted charge.

changed_reading.after: Remain faithfully with the entrusted work while your Lord nurtures it toward completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لربك names the relation for which فاصبر is undertaken.
baseline_models.mechanism: A covenantal image within رب and a surety image within صبر converge: the imperative can carry a relational obligation to remain answerable, not only an affective capacity to tolerate pain.

activation_trace.role: The covenant or pact image makes the relation to the Lord binding and answerable.
Bearing surety supplies the functional posture of personally standing behind the covenantal charge.

changed_reading.before: Exercise an inward virtue for God.
changed_reading.after: Stand personally answerable for a binding charge owed to your Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee is called from an enveloped state into rising and warning before being told to endure. Patience therefore regulates an exposed public mission; it does not authorize withdrawal from it.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority orient the public task to a higher command rather than the audience's response.
Restraint from panic becomes the internal control needed while acting publicly.
The outer covering supplies the enclosed starting state from which the mission emerges.
Resolve and rising toward a task supply active mobilization rather than passive waiting.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the outward work whose pressure patience must govern.

structural_cues: The address to the wrapped one is immediately followed by قم فأنذر, and فاصبر comes only after the mission commands.
The repeated imperative sequence makes action prior to endurance in discourse order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, rising, and warning; I infer that patience is the mission's control system. A live alternative is that it concerns only the hostility expected after warning.

changed_reading.after: Rise, warn, and restrain panic while remaining publicly exposed for your Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Magnifying the Lord, purifying the garment/self, and separating from disturbance establish an ordered boundary. Patience is what keeps that reorientation and boundary from collapsing under pressure.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the center around which the preceding acts are reordered.
Self-restraint supplies the persistence that preserves the newly ordered boundary.
Magnifying something within the breast supplies an intentional re-scaling around the Lord.
Garment, including its use as a figure for the self, makes purification both outward and personal.
Purifying self and action from ugliness supplies the positive boundary maintenance.
Disturbance and repeated motion supply the destabilizing contamination from which separation is required.
Cutting off and parting supply the negative boundary that complements purification.

structural_cues: Ayat 3-5 form consecutive object-fronted commands before the matching لربك command in 74:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies magnification, cleansing, disturbance, and separation; I infer one consecrating sequence whose stability requires patience. They may alternatively remain independent duties.

changed_reading.after: Hold the Lord-centered, purified boundary steady when disturbance presses against it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding prohibition blocks turning a gift into leverage for multiplication. لربك relocates the reason for endurance away from recipient response or accumulated return: patience sustains service without keeping a social profit ledger.

activation_trace.role: Lordship makes the Lord, not the recipient or return, the governing beneficiary of endurance.
Restraint from panic also restrains the impulse to secure recognition or repayment.
Burdening a beneficiary by recalling a favor supplies the prohibited social leverage.
Competitive multiplication by number supplies the return-seeking calculus that patience interrupts.

structural_cues: ولا تمنن تستكثر immediately precedes ولربك فاصبر, contrasting increase-seeking with Lord-directed endurance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor-based burden and competitive increase; I infer a transactional motive that لربك displaces. تستكثر could instead mean merely regarding one's deed as great.

changed_reading.before: Endure until service produces visible results or gratitude.
changed_reading.after: Keep serving for your Lord without converting the gift into leverage, recognition, or multiplied return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement is an abrupt striking that opens into a severe event with ease explicitly denied. Patience becomes stored readiness for discontinuity: composure must survive a sudden puncture, not only a long delay.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign authority gives the stable orientation across the impending rupture.
Severe inescapable trouble supplies the pressure profile that the following scene realizes.
Striking or pricking until a mark or hole appears supplies the sudden breach in settled continuity.
The event and severity of a day concentrate the rupture into a decisive occasion.
Difficulty and severity specify the event's constricting force.
Opening and ease after hardship, explicitly negated by غير, supply the relief that is withheld.

structural_cues: فإذا marks an abrupt conditional transition immediately after the focus ayah.
عسير is reinforced by غير يسير across 74:9-10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a puncturing strike, severity, and negated ease; I infer that the prior imperative stores composure for abrupt discontinuity. It may instead prepare only for ordinary opposition before that day.

changed_reading.after: Maintain Lord-directed composure that can survive a sudden breach when no easy release opens.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth is stretched out and followed by appetite for further increase. The split رب inventory contains both nurturing growth and sheer increase; context polarizes them. لربك directs patience toward being formed by the Nurturer instead of making divine relation a claim on compounding surplus.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply growth as formative care rather than acquisition.
The non-dominant mapped image of increase and rising exposes the surplus sense that context contests.
Self-restraint checks the appetite to turn nurture into entitlement to more.
Possessing abundant wealth supplies the existing surplus from which appetite proceeds.
Drawing something out continuously supplies the image of wealth extended without a near endpoint.
The heart's covetous hope supplies the acquisitive posture opposed to patient reception of nurture.
Seeking or bidding for increase names the compounding demand that the focus reading reverses.

structural_cues: 74:12-15 moves from extended wealth and present sons to ثم يطمع أن أزيد.
The focus root mapping itself is split between dominant رب and non-dominant ربو inventories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two mapped growth images plus extended wealth and appetite; I infer a contrast between formative growth and acquisitive increase. The split mapping may be formal resonance rather than intended polysemy.

changed_reading.before: Wait faithfully in expectation that the Lord will give more.
changed_reading.after: Accept the Nurturer's formative process without converting the relationship into an entitlement to compounding surplus.

context_deltas.mechanism: A staged chain moves from inward deliberation and calculation through looking, turning away, self-magnification, and public speech to a transmissible dismissive label. Patience becomes epistemic and rhetorical steadiness: do not let an opponent's manufactured frame reorganize the Lord-directed mission.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge cultivated under the Lord supplies an alternative center to the opponent's manufactured account.
Restraint from panic supplies non-reactivity while the hostile frame is constructed and broadcast.
The heart's repeated turning over a matter supplies the inward beginning of the constructed frame.
Planning a matter by estimation and scrutiny supplies deliberate calibration rather than spontaneous misunderstanding.
Directing sight or insight toward an object supplies the evaluative inspection stage.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the bodily conversion of calculation into refusal.
Greatness and pride supply the self-enlargement that authorizes the refusal in its maker's eyes.
Producing speech externalizes the inwardly prepared judgment for public circulation.
Diversion and deception supply the dismissive category imposed on the warning.
Transmission until a report becomes inherited supplies the label's claim to derivative circulation.

structural_cues: The repeated ثم in 74:18-24 stages cognition, expression, withdrawal, and speech rather than presenting one isolated insult.
The final قال converts the private sequence into a public claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered cognitive, bodily, and speech acts; I infer a manufactured persuasion process. The sequence may instead only expose culpability without describing a reusable social frame.

changed_reading.before: Bear the pain of being insulted or disbelieved.
changed_reading.after: Remain cognitively and rhetorically steady while a deliberate dismissive label is manufactured and circulated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counted sign functions as an assay that stabilizes some knowers and agitates doubt in others, while the Lord's forces exceed human knowledge. Patience is tolerance of epistemic asymmetry: fidelity need not force one sign to yield the same result in every hearer or exhaust what belongs to the Lord's knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge formed under the Lord makes patient fidelity compatible with incomplete human comprehension.
Restraint from panic prevents divergent audience effects from forcing premature explanatory control.
Enumerating what is counted supplies the bounded datum around which reactions diverge.
Assaying metal or a person makes the datum function as a revealer of the hearer's condition.
Stabilized knowledge with doubt removed supplies one possible product of the assay.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrasting response that the same datum can expose.
Disclosure to a knower marks knowledge as an achieved relation, not mere possession of the number.
A mutually supporting host supplies the unenumerated reality beyond the disputed count.
The Lord's ownership and authority locate that unexhausted host outside human explanatory control.

structural_cues: One number in 74:31 is explicitly assigned divergent effects: certainty, increased faith, absence of doubt, and questioning.
وما يعلم جنود ربك إلا هو places a knowledge limit inside the same ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assay, opposed epistemic effects, and a knowledge limit; I infer that patience refuses to coerce uniform uptake or exhaustive explanation. The test may target hearers without directly prescribing the messenger's epistemic posture.

changed_reading.before: Persist until every ambiguity is explained and every hearer is persuaded.
changed_reading.after: Remain faithful under your Lord when a bounded sign tests hearers differently and his full resources remain unknowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night's retreat and dawn's uncovering place endurance inside a changing temporal field, while the later advance/retreat contrast preserves agency. Patience is neither frozen waiting nor guaranteed visibility; it is durable forward alignment through obscurity as disclosure arrives on a larger schedule.

activation_trace.role: Staying and lasting supply persistence across a temporal transition.
Self-restraint keeps the agent aligned while visibility changes.
The ending and passing of a thing supply night as a receding phase rather than a permanent condition.
The first light of day supplies the temporal threshold after obscurity.
Removing a cover supplies disclosure as an uncovering rather than an achievement forced by the patient agent.
Advancing forward supplies the active direction available within the changing field.
Deferral to a later time supplies the opposed choice of falling behind.

structural_cues: The oaths by moon, retreating night, and uncovering dawn precede the explicit لمن شاء choice to advance or delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receding cover, emerging disclosure, and opposed motion; I infer that patience coordinates agency with a larger temporal process. The images can alternatively serve only as attestations of the warning's magnitude.

changed_reading.after: Keep a forward Lord-directed alignment through obscurity while disclosure unfolds on a schedule you do not control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each self is held as collateral by what it acquires, and later an added advocate cannot confer benefit. These legal-economic images activate the focus's covenant-and-surety branches: patience is personally standing behind the Lord's charge when answerability cannot be transferred.

activation_trace.role: The covenant or pact image supplies the binding obligation behind personal answerability.
Bearing surety supplies the focus-anchored posture of standing behind the obligation.
Seeking and acquiring benefit supplies the acts whose yield becomes personally attributable.
A document or object held against a right supplies the explicit collateral structure.
Benefit opposed to harm, here negated, blocks rescue through an external gain.
An advocate joining another supplies the attempted transfer or supplementation that proves ineffective.

structural_cues: كل نفس بما كسبت رهينة states universal personal attachment before the exception in 74:39.
فما تنفعهم شفاعة الشافعين later negates benefit from an added advocate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, collateral, joining advocacy, and negated benefit; I infer a non-transferable surety relation back into صبر. The legal image should remain an analogy, not replace the ordinary imperative sense.

changed_reading.before: Possess patience as a private psychological trait.
changed_reading.after: Stand personally behind your Lord's charge as a surety whose answerability cannot be outsourced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The confessional list pairs abandoned worship and feeding of the immobilized poor with immersion in group discourse and denial of account. Patience is therefore embodied constancy: remain in worship and material solidarity while refusing the current that normalizes denial.

activation_trace.role: Lordship gives worship, care, and resistance to group pressure one governing allegiance.
Standing with someone extends endurance from inward control to durable solidarity.
The specified act of worship supplies a repeated practice in which constancy must take form.
Feeding another supplies the material action that prevents patience from becoming private stoicism.
The abasement of destitution identifies the vulnerable person with whom durable standing is required.
Entering deeply into talk or an affair supplies the social current that carries participants together.
Contradiction of truth supplies the settled denial produced within that current.
Accounting and requital supply the horizon that makes the practices answerable rather than optional.

structural_cues: The repeated لم نك / كنا clauses in 74:43-46 form one causal confession spanning ritual, social care, group participation, and belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the linked omissions and participation; I infer that فاصبر positively sustains the practices whose absence is confessed. The list can also function diagnostically without defining patience itself.

changed_reading.before: Patiently withstand harm as an isolated believer.
changed_reading.after: Stay constant in worship and feeding the vulnerable while resisting the discursive current that normalizes denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is met by lateral turning, startle-driven distancing, and outright flight under perceived pursuit. Patience becomes counter-flight attention: remain present to warning and keep delivering it without letting threat reflex dictate direction.

activation_trace.role: Staying, clinging, and lasting supply the opposite posture to startled dispersal.
Restraint from panic directly counters the flight reflex described later.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the object from which the audience recoils.
Turning one's side supplies the first directional withdrawal from the reminder.
The familiar wild-ass image gives the withdrawal a bodily herd form rather than an abstract disagreement.
Recoiling and distancing supply the startle motion away from contact.
Flight and escape complete the audience's movement away from reminder.
The pursuing force supplies perceived threat as the flight trigger.

structural_cues: 74:49 asks about turning away, and 74:50-51 immediately renders that posture as a flight simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, lateral turning, distancing, flight, and pursuit; I infer patience as the contrary attentional posture for both messenger and hearer. The simile primarily describes rejecters, so its application to the messenger is contrastive.

changed_reading.before: Do not feel fear while others reject the message.
changed_reading.after: Hold attention and direction under threat reflex, neither fleeing the reminder nor abandoning its delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close returns to reminder, nests human willing within divine willing, and names God as worthy of protective alignment and forgiveness. This retrospectively softens a merely punitive model: patience remains answerable but is sustained inside a relationship that protects and repairs after fault.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord-directed relation capable of recovery and formation.
Standing with an entrusted relation supplies durable participation rather than punitive self-hardening.
The reminder that restores recollection reopens orientation after the long warning sequence.
Will directed toward a thing supplies genuine human responsiveness to the reminder.
The same willing branch at the divine level encloses human response within a larger agency.
The worshiped deity identifies the larger willing agency as the proper object of devoted endurance.
Fitness and worthiness govern both following relations, presenting protection and forgiveness as proper to God.
Repelling harm through protection supplies a sheltering rather than merely threatening relation.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer from its effect supplies reparative possibility after failure.

structural_cues: The closing sequence moves from تذكرة to paired human and divine willing, then to the balanced أهل التقوى وأهل المغفرة.
The final paired predicates prevent warning from being the surah's only relational register.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested willing, worthiness, protection, and forgiving cover; I infer that these retrospectively qualify the Lord for whom patience is exercised. They may close the surah without redefining the earlier imperative's immediate force.

changed_reading.before: Harden yourself to endure a solely punitive command.
changed_reading.after: Remain answerably with your Lord inside a relation that both protects from harm and permits repaired return after fault.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because two remote nominal branches converge on layered cloud imagery; it remains anchored to both focus roots and yields an accumulating rather than merely static model of endurance. Render only as a material analogy, never as a lexical translation of لربك فاصبر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both lexical roots in 74:7 independently carry a layered-cloud branch.

activation_trace.role: A low or layered cloud supplies gathering persistence associated with sustained nurture or rain.
A white layered cloud independently repeats accumulation and layering on the patience side of the construction.

changed_reading.before: Patience is a fixed inner reserve.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Lord-directed endurance gathers layer by layer until it can carry a later release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The stopper sense of صبر is branch-distant and the image of resolve leaking through a puncture is reader-supplied; it remains focus-anchored and is activated by the next ayah's striking-hole branch. Downstream prose should mark it as a mechanical analogy for containment under shock, not a proposed gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فاصبر carries the stopper branch, while لربك fixes the purpose of containment.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority identify what the contained resolve remains held for.
A stopper or plug supplies a mechanical image of preventing loss through an opening.
A strike that leaves a mark or hole supplies the contextual rupture against which the stopper image works.

changed_reading.before: Endurance absorbs pressure in a general way.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, endurance seals resolve for the Lord when a sudden strike punctures settled order.

strongest_changes: The preceding rise-and-warn sequence revises patience from withdrawal into disciplined control inside public action.
ولا تمنن تستكثر makes Lord-directed endurance non-transactional rather than a way to secure recognition or multiplied return.
The count-as-test and unknown-host sequence turns patience into fidelity under divergent uptake and bounded human knowledge.
The collateral, worship, feeding, and group-immersion sequence makes patience personally answerable and materially solidaristic.
The closing protection and forgiveness language prevents endurance from hardening into a solely punitive relation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots generated several coherent cross-domain mechanisms: sovereignty plus self-restraint, nurture plus durable fidelity, covenant plus surety, and even a double layered-cloud resonance. The split رب mapping also exposed a live contrast between formative growth and acquisitive increase.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ر ب و increase branch may be a useful formal resonance rather than intended polysemy in رب.
Covenant, collateral, stopper, and cloud readings should remain analogical activations rather than replacement translations.
The degree to which the final protection-and-forgiveness relation retrospectively governs the immediate imperative remains open.
